equivalent_mutants.reason: Checked original 0x464eb0 and 0x464ec0: each only converts its fixed signed integer argument and stores an exact double at receiver+0x68 or +0x70, with no nested calls. Swapping these independent stores changes neither memory nor x87 state; both integers are exactly representable and the balanced load/store pairs end at the same TOP and status.

Checked original 0x464187 and 0x46418f: signed loop-angle FILD and zero store to record+0x48 have independent operands and destinations. Swapping the two operations cannot affect memory, x87 state, or any outside event; no call occurs between them.

Checked original 0x4634b9 and 0x4c7970, including 0x4f6286 -> 0x4f5d5c -> strcmp. Resource initialization reads the render object and its resource dictionary, writes render+0x170/+0x16c/+0x174, and never reads the Omar vtable or invokes a callback/fixture. Swapping the Omar vtable publication across this call is unobservable on valid original object graphs.

Checked unchanged original base 0x44c6ec initializes receiver+0x2b8 to -10 before Omar 0x4637ca repeats it, with no intervening writer. The shifted store targets +0x2bc, which original 0x4637d4 overwrites immediately before any read or call. Both original and shifted forms therefore have identical observable state.

Checked unchanged original base 0x44c71a initializes receiver+0x2c4 to 20 before Omar 0x4637e8 repeats it. No intervening original callee writes that field. Dropping the repeated store preserves its value and every outside-call state.

Checked unchanged original base 0x44c6a1 initializes receiver+0x28c to 500 before Omar 0x4637fc repeats it. The shifted destination +0x290 is overwritten with 40 by 0x463806 immediately before any read or call; the original +0x28c remains 500 in either form.

Checked unchanged original base 0x44c700 initializes receiver+0x298 to 40 before Omar 0x463816 repeats it. No intervening original callee writes that field, so dropping the redundant store cannot change behavior.

Checked unchanged original base 0x44c6bb initializes receiver+0x2a0 to 40 before Omar 0x463826 repeats it. Shifted destination +0x2a4 is overwritten with 56 at 0x46382c immediately before any read or call; +0x2a0 remains 40 in both forms.

Checked original constructor 0x4638f9 and ring creation 0x464147/0x46414d: moving the early defense=1 store from +0xd1c to +0xd20 is overwritten by the following toggle=1 store, and ring creation unconditionally writes both fields to 1 before its first outside call. Between the constructor store and those creation stores there is no read of either field and no outside event.

notes: Reviewed against original instruction bodies: constructor thiscall1 returning receiver, live position thiscall1 void, ring creation thiscall0 void. All three owned; constructor always creates nine rings after zeroing slots.
